title: [Bug] Intermittent CUDA device-side crash with DSPARK speculative decoding on DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [ ] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

An sglang 0.5.16 server running DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with DSPARK speculative decoding crashes intermittently with `CUDA error: device-side assert triggered`. The underlying assertion is `probability tensor contains either 'inf', 'nan' or element < 0`, raised by an async CUDA kernel in `TensorCompare.cu` (i.e. a `torch.multinomial`/sampling-related check). All 8 TP ranks fail simultaneously and the whole server exits. Frequency is very low: roughly once per week under production traffic.

## Environment

- **GPU**: 8 × H100
- **sglang**: v0.5.16 (runtime image `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.16-runtime`)
- **Model**: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731

## Launch Command

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
    --model-path "$WORKSPACE_PATH" \
    --port 8000 \
    --tp 8 \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --context-length 1000000 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-running-requests 40 \
    --moe-runner-backend marlin \
    --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \
    --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 \
    --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 \
    --served-model-name ai-search
```

## Symptom

After ~1 week of stable serving, the server crashes.

### Reproduction

```
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
    --model-path "$WORKSPACE_PATH" \
    --port 8000 \
    --tp 8 \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --context-length 1000000 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-running-requests 40 \
    --moe-runner-backend marlin \
    --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \
    --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 \
    --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 \
    --served-model-name ai-search
```
